entities.name: UniProt Q8NGL1
observations: Reviewed human olfactory receptor 5D18; supplied 313-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
Annotated as an odorant receptor, plasma-membrane multipass GPCR involved in olfactory receptor activity, GPCR signaling, and sensory perception of smell.
Sequence-derived estimates: 35.35 kDa, pI 8.68, GRAVY 0.792; Pfam 7tm_1 and 7tm_4 domains detected.
